svg.text: Cold passive / noise laws remain unmeasured
Four-channel MIM physical benchmark | one real clock, one shared bank
Each channel contains the accepted CSA/Cf, comparator, STD controller and current replenisher.
Shared references and phases use matching named taps at all receivers. Detector and channel control nets are independent.
One external master set: CSA, comparator and replenisher currents; VCM and threshold voltages.
Detector capacitance, explicit initial charge and physical stimuli belong in the testbenches. No CSA reset is added.
Coupled whole-core extraction; all four CSA/Cf, comparator, controller and replenishment loops are physical.
Numerical charge initialization is explicit. DC closures are absent from all transient acquisitions.
warm_50m: 50 MHz; A-F words 768, 822, 812, 838, 831, 935; replenisher master scale 0.325014.
UPSTREAM SUPPLIES | finite 1-ohm feeds and 100-pF VDD/VSS decoupling on each rail
EXTERNAL MASTER REFERENCES | three currents shared by four channels; no ideal receiver references
SINGLE EXTERNAL CLOCK / CONTROL | RESET initializes digital control; it does not reset Cf
INDEPENDENT CHANNEL INPUTS / OVERRIDES | initial benchmark: channel 0 active, channels 1-3 quiet
ACTUAL WELL JUNCTIONS | one supplement per connected physical NWELL; no distributed substrate model
